assertion_analysis.fails_when: The observed process_alive value differs from the state established by an owned live child, a terminated and waited child, or an incomplete worker record; expected_alive is not supplied to classify_pointer.
Nonterminal manifests are classified as something other than running in any of the three cases; running is an independent expected policy result.
The exited branch stops emitting process ended, for example if False is routed to the unknown wording.
The exited branch loses the not reported dead qualification.
The base broad else is reinstated, emitting process ended for unknown liveness, or the live branch is given ended wording; the base log demonstrates failure for unknown.
Either live or unknown wording gains not reported dead; reinstating the base broad else violates this assertion for unknown, although line 63 stops that arm first.
Unknown liveness is routed to a generic live or ended message without unknown; reinstating the base broad else violates this assertion, although line 63 stops that arm first.
